Battle orders

Blue borders: move. Red borders: attack. Tap an enemy to inspect the damage.

Field manual

Each unit moves once and attacks once. Attacking ends its turn.

Capture a village by entering it. Each owned village earns 2 gold at the start of your turn and heals a friendly occupant by 2 HP.

Melee attacks trigger one retaliation if the defender survives and has a melee attack. Bow attacks don’t trigger retaliation, and archers never retaliate.

Forests cost 2 movement and reduce ranged damage by 1. Hills cost 2 movement and reduce all damage by 1. Water is impassable.

Select your commander on your keep to recruit into an adjacent empty hex. Recruits act next turn.

Defeat the enemy commander to win. Keyboard: Tab to the map, use arrow keys to browse hexes, Enter to select. Escape cancels recruitment.
